has signed a contract with Florida International University (FIU) to deliver its Superion 256-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer for installation at FIU, the company said on Thursday.
This contract establishes FIU as IonQ’s flagship academic partner in Florida, creating a central hub for quantum research and education across the region.
It marks the first sale and deployment of a Superion 256 trapped-ion quantum computer in Florida.
